entries.title: Psalms 53:1
segments: This psalm is, for substance, the same as

. 
 
Those who say, There is no God, even in their hearts, are dupes of their own wickedness and folly.

entries.title: Psalms 53:2
segments: None naturally seek after God, nor will any ever do it without the influences of his grace.

entries.title: Psalms 53:5
segments:
Where no fear was; no external cause of fear. 
 
God can fill the wicked with trembling and consternation in the absence of all external appearances of danger; and in the end, more and greater evils than they feared will come upon them.

entries.title: Psalms 53:6
segments:
Bringeth back the captivity of his people; delivers them from trouble, and bestows upon them prosperity. 
 
Let the righteous wait patiently upon God, and their highest expectations will be more than realized.
